title: Uniproma advances sunscreen formulation with lipid microsphere encapsulation
summary: Sunsafe Fusion C4 and C5 combine multiple organic UV filters within a pre-dispersed lipid microsphere system, supporting enhanced UVA and UVB protection, stable dispersion and convenient incorporation. Uniproma will showcase the technology and sunscreen prototypes at in-cosmetics Asia 2026

extraction.key_fact: Uniproma가 여러 자외선 차단 성분을 지질 마이크로스피어에 담은 소재를 선보인다.
